full_judgment:
Mr. A.B.M. Khairul Haque J:- This is a petition for leave to appeal. The facts leading to the filing of this petition, in brief, are that the respondent No.1 instituted a case being the Miscellaneous Case No.24 of 1997, praying for pre-emption of the case-land whereupon the pre-emptee-petitioner contested the case by filing a written objection, denying all material allegations. After hearing, the learned Assistant Judge, Rowmari, Kurigram, by his judgment and order dated 26.04.1999, dismissed the miscellaneous case. On appeal, being the Miscellaneous Appeal No.26 of 1999, the judgment and order passed by the learned Assistant Judge was set-aside by the judgment and order dated 26.04.1999, passed by the learned Additional District Judge, Kurigram, allowing pre-emption. 

 2. Being aggrieved, the pre-emptee-petitioner preferred the Civil Revision No.6289 of 2002 and the high Court Division by its judgment and order dated 29.06.2009, concurred with the findings of the Appellate Court below that the pre-emptee is a subsequent purchaser from the common vendor and is a stranger to case land and on these findings, discharged the Rule. 

 5. Since the findings of the Appellate Court and the High Court Division are that the pre-emptee-petitioner is a subsequent purchaser in the case land, this petition does not merit consideration. However, the petitioner-pre-emptee is entitled to the development cost of Tk.10,000/-.
